caption.text:
Polda Metro Jaya meningkatkan keamanan di markasnya, jelang konferensi pers terkait kasus blackout hingga ASABRI. Berdasarkan pantauan kumparan, sejumlah personel Brimob sudah disebar di sejumlah titik di sekitar markas. ⁠
⁠
Penjagaan paling ketat juga nampak di dekat Gedung Promoter Polda Metro Jaya. Nampak sejumlah Brimob bersenjata lengkap berjaga di sekitar gedung.  Lalu, nampak pula beberapa sejumlah kontainer yang dibawa keluar dari gedung Promoter. ⁠
⁠
Kortastipidkor Polri dan Ditreskrimsus Polda Metro Jaya saat ini memang tengah gencar melakukan joint investigation penyidikan tiga kasus dugaan korupsi besar yang merugikan negara hingga triliunan rupiah.⁠
⁠
Ketiga kasus tersebut di antaranya TPPU serta suap perkara dugaan suap di PT Asabri-Jiwasraya, korupsi pasokan batu bara yang memicu blackout massal di sejumlah wilayah di Indonesia, dan perkara korupsi yang berkaitan dengan Krakatau Steel. ⁠
⁠
Dalam rangkaian penyidikan tersebut, penyidik Polri menggeledah belasan tempat dan menemukan sederet barang bukti, seperti puluhan kilogram emas, mata uang asing, yang bernilai sekitar Rp 476 miliar.⁠
⁠
📸: Dok. kumparan/Nauval Pratama.⁠

caption.text_translation:
Police Metro Jaya increases security at its headquarters, ahead of press conference related to blackout case to ASABRI. Based on coil monitoring, a number of Brimob personnel have been deployed at a number of points around the headquarters.

The strictest security is also seen near the Pulda Metro Jaya Promoter Building. Spotted a number of fully armed Brimobs guarding around the building. Then, it appears that a number of containers were taken out of the Promoter building.

Kortastipidkor Polri and Ditreskrimsus Polda Metro Jaya are currently in the midst of conducting a joint investigation of three cases of alleged big corruption that cost the country up to trillions of rupiah.

The three cases include TPPU as well as bribery in PT Asabri-Jiwasraya, corruption in coal supply that triggered mass blackouts in some provinces in Indonesia, and corruption related to Krakatau Steel.

In the series of searches, Polri investigators searched dozens of places and found a series of evidence, such as tens of kilograms of gold, foreign currency, worth around Rp 476 billion.

 📸: Dok. kumparan/Nauval Pratama.
